HighGammaBandPass.Description: Authors' preprocessing: 3 kHz ECoG resampled to 400 Hz and band-passed to 70-150 Hz high gamma (Gaussian filter bank, release code/utils/Hilbert_transform.py; common average reference per the release *_ieeg.json). The release metadata say a Hilbert envelope was taken, but the stored signal is the band-passed signal itself, not its envelope (zero mean, about half of the samples negative, 94-96 % of the power in 70-150 Hz).

Instructions: High-gamma ECoG when listening to the Mandarin corpus during awake craniotomy
